js: (async () => { const d = window.__dbg; const p = d.play; const car = p.car; const inp = d.input; let body = null; d.physics.world.bodies.forEach((b) => { if (!body && b.isDynamic() && b.mass() > 800 && Math.hypot(b.translation().x - car.position.x, b.translation().z - car.position.z) < 4) body = b; }); p.seat(); let t = 400; const step = (n, fn) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (fn) fn(i); p.update(1 / 60, (t += 1 / 60)); } }; body.setTranslation({ x: 300, y: 26, z: 0 }, true); body.setLinvel({ x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }, true); body.setAngvel({ x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }, true); const log = []; inp.hold('Space', true); step(150, (i) => { if (i % 30 === 0) log.push(['lift', Math.round(car.position.x), Math.round(car.position.y), Math.round(car.position.z)]); }); inp.hold('Space', false); inp.hold('KeyW', true); inp.hold('ShiftLeft', true); step(1200, (i) => { if (i % 60 === 0) log.push([Math.round(car.position.x), Math.round(car.position.y), Math.round(car.position.z), car.state.flightMode]); }); inp.hold('KeyW', false); inp.hold('ShiftLeft', false); return { flight: log, maxX: Math.max(...log.filter((l) => typeof l[0] === 'number').map((l) => l[0])) }; })()
